reading.objective: Announce a contemporary art exhibition about light and memory and make it feel like the show itself.
reading.audience: Art-literate gallery visitors and press in a northern European city.
reading.feeling: Quiet, exact, slightly dizzy: the sensation of a bright thing lingering after it has gone.

concept.idea: An afterimage drawn literally: a luminous red field and its complementary teal ghost, displaced and overlapping, the way the eye leaves a trace after looking at light.
decisions: structure: weight sits in the upper-left as one large doubled block; the title lies beneath it as a heavy horizontal, details stay small at the foot, so the eye drops from the image of light to its name
read first: the doubled block, then Afterimage, then the subhead in a narrow column beside the block
type: Instrument Serif for the title, tall and tightly tracked, with an outlined echo offset behind it like a trace; Instrument Sans for small text
colour: warm paper ground, near-black ink, a hot red and its complement teal; multiply makes the overlap a dark fused zone, as the eye mixes the two
forms: two identical rectangles, one offset, nothing else decorative
